text:
Alex Kim: hey folks — accepted the org invite but GitHub shows me as 'Outside collaborator' and I only see a couple public repos. need access to infra/monorepo (private). who should i ping?
Emma (People Ops): hey Alex — usually that means the invite landed on your personal account instead of the SSO one. did you accept with alex@redwood.com or a personal email?
Alex Kim: accepted with alex@redwood.com (i think). my profile also shows another account 'alexkim.dev' though. ran `ssh -T git@github.com` and got 'Hi alex! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.' not sure which account that's coming from.
Marcus (Eng Manager): can you paste the GitHub profile URL you see (no tokens)? SCIM/SSO usually maps the SSO-managed account; if the invite was delivered to your personal account we can either merge or re-send. @it-ops can you take a look at provisioning logs?
it-ops: checking SCIM logs now. looks like we have two identities: `alex-kim` (SSO-provisioned) and `alexkim` (personal). the invite email was clicked while logged into the personal account, so GitHub accepted on that one. options: 1) add your work email to the personal account temporarily and accept, then remove it; or 2) we revoke the personal invite and re-send to your SSO account. which would you prefer?
Alex Kim: i'd prefer to keep personal separate. happy to have you revoke/re-send to SSO account.
onboarding-bot: note — if you add work email to personal account you must verify it and ensure email visibility doesn't expose company email. steps if needed: Settings > Emails > Add alex@redwood.com > verify > accept invite > remove email.
Marcus (Eng Manager): i'll wait on the re-send so we don't mix accounts. @Emma can you coordinate with Alex and it-ops?
Emma (People Ops): will do. Alex, can you DM me the GitHub profile URL and a screenshot of the invite email (no token)? i'll coordinate the re-send and team add.
Alex Kim: DM sent. thanks! :pray:
it-ops: update — revoked invite to personal account and re-sent to SSO account `alex-kim`. also pre-added you to team `eng-platform/monorepo-read` as provisional so you can clone once invite is accepted. check your Redwood email and spam.
Alex Kim: accepted the new invite, can see infra/monorepo now and clone succeeded. `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra-monorepo.git` worked. ssh -T now says 'Hi alex-kim! You've successfully authenticated.' all good from my side.
Marcus (Eng Manager): awesome — welcome aboard :tada: i'll add you to the CODEOWNERS for docs/<your-team-path> and ping you about onboarding tasks later.
Emma (People Ops): closing loop — let us know if any other perms are missing. welcome again! :)
